name: com.yu5h1.uitoolkit
description: UI Toolkit runtime gestures, manipulators, controls and panel/world bridging from Yu5h1

samples.description: A draggable, throwable desktop with a float Apps panel, assembled only from Yu5h1Lib packages. The hands-on rig for the things no unit test judges: group drag, inertia, the throw, the hold and its swallowed click, the catch wobble, the staggered entrance.

A chat panel and capsule composer assembled from Yu5h1Lib.UIToolkit's ChatPresenter and ChatComposer: bottom-anchored message stacking, streamed replies with a thinking indicator, position fade, overlay scrollbar, Enter-to-send with an IME guard, and DevicePanel scaling with safe-area padding. Reply texts and thinking times are editable in the Inspector.
A minimal visual sample demonstrating UxButton appearance (solid/ghost), display combinations, size scaling, and selection states under the default runtime theme.
A visual and interaction sample for UX OptionPicker 3.0.2 demonstrating Visibility (picker, aligned) and Sorting (both, adjacent) option pickers.
